name: Apprenticeship — Pause Becomes Withdrawal
description: Creates a 2-year apprenticeship (2025-08-01 to 2027-07-31), PUTs a pause date of 2026-03-01 (temporary break), then PUTs again with the pause removed and a withdrawal date of 2026-03-01 instead — the break was initially recorded as temporary but subsequently confirmed as permanent

steps.name: Wait — inspect DB after pause, then continue with withdrawal
